{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Pundits and Democrats suggest accepting a slow-growing economy.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Obama and the Democratic Party will set a record of being the first modern president to leave office without a single calendar year of three percent economic growth.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The number of Americans living in poverty has increased by 7 million under President Obama and the Democratic Party.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The nation's economy has lost nearly $8 trillion of cumulative output compared with an average recovery under President Obama and the Democratic Party.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The economic growth shortfall has left a cumulative real after-tax per person personal income shortfall of nearly $17,000 compared with an average recovery under President Obama and the Democratic Party.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"New private-sector jobs are three million below where they should have been with just average modern post-recession growth under President Obama and the Democratic Party.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The labor force participation rate has plunged to at or below 63 percent for far too long, reaching lows last seen two generations ago before President Reagan was elected in 1980.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Business closures have exceeded business startups throughout the Obama Presidency.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Strong growth, more jobs, increasing incomes, and expanding opportunity are all in short supply under President Obama and the Democratic Party.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
